title: When the Aftermath Burns
author: W. M. Underhill
blurb: Bram Blackwood, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
